posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Athletic’s DeFabo believes Jaylen Warren is constantly overlooked: “Jaylen Warren has been overlooked since he came into the league as an undrafted free agent. He spent his early years as the third-down back behind Najee Harris. Last year, Warren was 1B in a backfield split that favored Kenneth Gainwell. This year, with Rico Dowdle injured, Warren is finally the lead back. He’s thriving in that role and has racked up the fourth-most yards per carry (5.6), the fifth-most yards after contact (3.76) and the fourth-most receiving yards (143) among running backs. If there’s one Steeler consistently playing to expectations, it’s Warren.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Fittipaldo thinks the Steelers CB Situation is not looking great: “You’re getting two guys basically off other teams’ practice squad and you’re trying to teach them a system within a couple of days. Now, they’re not gonna play a lot, but if there’s an injury, you would think one of those guys is gonna have to play. Patrick Graham was pretty adamant the other day, he has no designs on moving Jalen Ramsey. So it’s Asante Samuel Jr., it’s Daylen Everette, and then it’s the two new guys that they picked up. So, yeah, not a great situation.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text: Mark Madden says the Steelers need to fire Omar Khan and get a Real GM: “It’s amazing how little offensive talent they have. For a coordinator like McCarthy and a quarterback like Rodgers, the lack of skill talent on the Steelers’ offense is absolutely appalling. What they needed to do, and still need to do moving forward but probably won’t, is fire Khan and get a real GM. At the very least, they need a GM who’s dialed into where the league is today and willing to get McCarthy the skill-position players he needs, because this ain’t it.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.
